ideas.label: Restriction / Domination
ideas.summary: Restriction reduces the opponent's useful moves before you attack. Control freeing squares and breaks, then improve your pieces without releasing their position.
games: Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
Guerra Mansilla, Jorge Maximilian vs Gutierrez Gomez, Nicolas 1999 2026 (E90)
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Restriction / Domination
ideas.principle: Preserve the structure that creates space
ideas.summary: A spatial advantage matters when the pawn structure denies good squares to enemy pieces. Avoid exchanges that free a cramped defender unless the resulting ending is clearly favorable.
games: Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
Guerra Mansilla, Jorge Maximilian vs Gutierrez Gomez, Nicolas 1999 2026 (E90)
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Restriction / Domination
ideas.principle: Build domination around a key square
ideas.summary: If control of e5 dominates the position, reinforce that square, neutralize the defender that contests it, and stop the freeing pawn break. Then redirect the least active piece toward the fixed weakness created by the restriction.
games: Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three
